subject: Public Comments Form
comment:
Dear Mayor and City Council Members,

We previously sent correspondence regarding the Mojave Crossing Project. As the upcoming City Council meeting on February 6 approaches, we feel it is necessary to once again bring the following concerns to your attention:

Changes to "The District at SunRiver" Plans

The plans for "The District at SunRiver," as posted on the SunRiver website, have been altered significantly and are now unrecognizable. As we mentioned before, our once-serene environment has already been disrupted by previous developments. The Mojave Crossing hotel project raises similar concerns for residents along Sandpiper Drive. Unfortunately, this pattern has become a recurring issue throughout the SunRiver community, as many residents can attest.

Parking and Traffic Concerns.

Parking has been a persistent issue with new developments in our area. To address this, we propose designating the entire length of Sandpiper Drive as a "no overnight parking zone." This measure would reduce congestion and ensure that emergency vehicles have unobstructed access to homes along this road. We noted that this option was thoughtfully discussed during the January 16 City Council meeting, and hope it will be added to the February 6 agenda for approval.

Additionally, while the proposed traffic exit onto Sandpiper Drive appears necessary, we are equally concerned about the expected increase in foot traffic into adjacent neighborhoods. Guests and their pets will likely seek walking areas, which may lead to intrusion into residential streets and sidewalks which are private. To mitigate this, we strongly urge the council to consider protective measures such as designated walking paths, signage, or barriers. Furthermore, we recommend the addition of a city park near the newer development to provide an appropriate space for guests and residents to enjoy.

We appreciate your attention to these concerns and urge you to prioritize the well-being of SunRiver residents while reviewing this project. We look forward to your response and to seeing the Mayor and City Council carefully consider the needs of our community.

Thank you for your time and dedication to our shared interests.

Jeffrey & Vickie Edwards
Sun River Residents
